com.ecom.admin.release_notes: Pin reports and comments, remove spam inquiries, and keep report details readable on small screens.

com.ecom.order.release_notes: Accurate order and invoice drill-through, supplementary order totals, full currency amounts, selected notice comments and shop-date navigation. Supply overdue deliveries now include the complete multi-date list. Update both apps for consistent list and detail information.

com.ecom.hrm.release_notes: Preserve ER operations during transition. View existing attendance and saved payroll in Workforce, with editing disabled until shop cutover.

com.ecom.supply.release_notes: See today’s incoming orders, upcoming production, unpaid invoices, and pending deliveries directly on Supply Home. Badges highlight work that needs attention.

com.ecom.beauty.release_notes: Show Location automatically from the registered shop address with directions from your current location. Remove map content editing and require verified owner or manager consent before ECOM homepage edits.

com.ecom.kiosk.release_notes: Added privacy-safe face template timing diagnostics and preserved validated Kiosk startup and shop-scoped cache behavior.

testflight.notes: Simpler navigation with Field, Overview, Reports and Manage. Find tools with management search, return to the same shop with Back, and keep report drafts while switching sections. Secondary history, monitoring and report tools are available on demand. Improved phone and tablet layouts in English and Korean.
